## Observed Facts

**Count.** Data Scope: BGL, messages containing "ciod" (case-insensitive substring), ts from 2005-06-01 up to but excluding 2005-07-01. There were **20,217 Log Entries** [E1]. By component: APP 13,409 [E1], KERNEL 6,803 [E1], MMCS 5 [E1].

**First match.** Ordered by timestamp, the first match is line 4988 at 2005-06-03 16:17:40.190183 on node R26-M0-NC-I:J18-U11 (APP, FATAL) [E2]:

> `ciod: Error loading /p/gb2/stella/RAPTOR/65641/raptor: invalid or missing program image, No such file or directory`

**Context (file order, lines 4983–4993) [E3]:**

Before:
- 4983 (16:12:36.079, KERNEL, INFO, R16-M1-N2-C:J17-U01): `total of 31 ddr error(s) detected and corrected`
- 4984 (16:16:26.300, KERNEL, INFO, R22-M0-NB-C:J12-U01): `generating core.257`
- 4985 (16:16:26.320, KERNEL, INFO, R22-M0-N9-C:J12-U01): `generating core.385`
- 4986 (16:16:26.862, KERNEL, INFO, R22-M0-NF-C:J10-U01): `generating core.65`
- 4987 (16:16:26.880, KERNEL, INFO, R22-M0-NF-C:J12-U01): `generating core.1`

After (all APP FATAL, same error text, same image path):
- 4989 at 16:17:40.232 on R26-M0-NC-I:J18-U01
- 4990 at 16:17:40.258 on R26-M0-N8-I:J18-U11
- 4991 at 16:17:40.284 on R26-M0-N8-I:J18-U01
- 4992 at 16:17:40.306 on R26-M0-N4-I:J18-U11
- 4993 at 16:17:40.326 on R26-M0-N4-I:J18-U01

The burst is about 0.02 s apart per line, across many nodes in the R26 rack.

## Hypotheses

- **Missing or moved program image.** The most direct reading is that the job's binary `/p/gb2/stella/RAPTOR/65641/raptor` was absent or not visible from the I/O nodes when the job was loaded. The error text says so directly. The logs do not show why.
- **Possibly unrelated to the cores.** The KERNEL "generating core" lines occur on R22 nodes about 1.5 minutes before the first ciod error, on different nodes. They may come from an earlier job failure, but this is not established by these lines alone.

## Unknowns

- Whether the "generating core" lines (4984–4987) are causally linked to the ciod errors. The logs show temporal proximity only.
- Why the image was missing: a file-system issue, a wrong job path, or a job-launch race. None of this appears in the retrieved lines.
- The total ciod-related volume is dominated by these repeated load failures, but the logs do not say how many distinct jobs were affected. I did not count by job id.

## Next Step

Check whether the same image path appears before 2005-06-03 16:17 and whether the error stops after a certain point:

`search_logs` (BGL, query `/p/gb2/stella/RAPTOR/65641`, start 2005-06-01, end 2005-07-01, limit 50), then `trend` (BGL, query `ciod: Error loading`, bucket hour) to see when the burst starts and ends.
